statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic events
The service was to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
